content: Tua hun sung, nungzui te hong khan ciang in, Greek te in Hebrew te langpan in kamtam na hong piang hi, banghangziam cile Greek meingong te sia nisim an a hawm uh ciang in ki ngaingonsak hi.
Tua zawkciang in sawltak sawm le ni te in nungzui mihonpi te amate kungah sam a, kote Pathian thu nusia in an ka hawm tu uh sia lungkim huai ngawl hi.
Tua ahikom, suapui te awng, noma sung pan in a belcing minpha, Tha Thiangtho le ciimna taw a kidim mi sali hong zong tavun a, hi nasep amate i ap tu hi.
Ahihang kote thungen le Pathian thu sungah a tawntung in ka kipumpiak tu uh hi, ci uh hi.

Taciang amate sonbang in mihonpi theampo lungkim uh a: amate in, upna le Tha Thiangtho taw a kidim Stephen, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas le Antioch khua mi Judah biakna ah a tum Nicolas te teal uh hi.
Amate sia sawltak te mai ah dingsak uh a, thu a ngetsak uh ciang in, amate lutung ah a khut nga uh hi.
Taciang Pathian thu hong khang a; Jerusalem ah nungzui te nasiatak in hong ki belap hi; taciang thiampi tampi te in upna thu zui uh hi.
Taciang upna le vangletna taw a kidim Stephen in, mite sungah a lian mama nalamdang le lim tumdang lianpi te vawt hi.
Tuazawkciang in A Suaktate synagogue a kici, synagogue sungah Cyrene mite, Alexandria mite, Cilicia mite le Asia mite Stephen taw thu kinial uh hi.
Amate in Stephen i ciimna le thaa taw a pauna te a nalh zo bua uh hi.
Tuazawkciang in amate in mite sumnguk pia ku uh a, tua te in, hisia pa in Moses le Pathian langpan in mindaisak na kammal te a pau sia kote in ka za uh hi, ci uh hi.
Taciang amate in mihonpi te, upa te le thukhamhil te hol uh a, Stephen kungah hongpai uh hi, taciang thudokpi te kungah paipui uh a,
Hisia pa in mun thiangtho le thukham langpan in mindaisak na kammal te tatsat ngawl in pau hi, ci uh hi, tabang in leilot tetti tampi koi uh hi:
Banghangziam cile, Nazareth mi Jesus in hi mun susia tu a, Moses i hongpiak thukham te lai tu hi, ci in hisia pa in a son ka za uh hi, ci uh hi.
Thudokpi te thukhen na mun ah a to theampo in, Stephen sia phatak in sal uh a, a maitang sia vantungmi te maitang bang in mu uh hi.
